claim.claim-text: 2. The drug delivery device of claim 1, a proximally facing surface of the flange sealingly engaging the end surface of the container to inhibit the ingress of contaminants.
3. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 or 2, the gaseous sterilizing agent including at least one of ethylene oxide or steam.

4. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 3, comprising a fluoropolymer film covering the septum entirely except for the proximally facing surface of the flange and a portion of an outer peripheral surface of the flange.

5. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 4, wherein the flange comprises an end portion having an outer peripheral surface which is exposed to the gaseous sterilizing agent during a sterilization procedure.

6. The drug delivery device of claim 5, wherein a length of the end portion of the flange is less than an overall length of the flange, and wherein a width of the end portion of the flange is equal to an overall width of the flange.

7. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 6, comprising a fastener engaging a distally facing surface of the septum and an exterior surface of the container to secure the flange against the end surface of the container, the fastener being permeable to the gaseous sterilizing agent.

8. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 7, comprising an annular rib extending outwardly of the proximal end of the septum and configured to sealingly engage an inner surface of the container.
9. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 8, an exterior surface of the housing being releasably attachable to a patient.

10. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 9, comprising an insertion mechanism configured to move a delivery member from a retracted position within the housing to a deployed position extending outside of the housing.

11. The drug delivery device of claim 10, comprising a hollow piercing member insertable through the septum to establish a fluid flow path between the container and the delivery member upon activation of the drug delivery device.
12. The drug delivery device of any one of claims 1 to 11, comprising a drive mechanism configured to expel the drug from the container upon activation of the drug delivery device.
